issues.on_page: Operating disbursements of an irrigation district
issues.issue: The disbursement rules list water and drainage districts under 'natural resources/conservation'. An irrigation district may belong there rather than in 'utilities'. This is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Water taxes 151,135 (p3: 'Cash received from water consumers')
issues.issue: Irrigation district water taxes are levied per irrigated acre and could be 'special assessments' or 'other taxes' instead. Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Debt service disbursements (6,907); p3: note redemption (33,908), interest (1,557), proceeds of promissory note 28,558
issues.issue: The printed line is a net figure that mixes principal, interest and new note proceeds. It is kept as printed with review, which is correct under the one-item-per-line rule, but the gross debt proceeds of 28,558 and the interest of 1,557 are not shown separately.
